messages:
eli: Starting geo-slice rollout v2.5.0. Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Window 22:45-02:45 UTC. Please confirm reserves.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy queued: v2.5.0 -> svc/redwood (canary 5% -> 30% -> 100%). Initial slice: us-east1 5%.

nora: EU warm-pool check: target 30, active 22. autoscaler inflight (ETA ~5m).

pip: Recommend US start. Hold EU until active >= 95% target. APAC blocked until EU completes.

rashid: rollback triggers set: error_rate +1.8% sustained 4m OR p95 > 1s sustained 5m -> auto-pin to v2.4.9.

deploy-bot: US canary 5% applied. Smoke: 6/6 checks passed. p95=430ms.

eli: good. @nora drop a note when EU hits 95%. then we'll start EU 5% slice.

nora: EU at 29/30 (96%). ready in 90s. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: EU canary queued: eu-central1 5%. Smoke running.

devops-bot: WARNING model-pull slow on eu-central1-2 (transient). retrying 2/3.

pip: if model-pull doesn't clear in 3 retries, pause EU and route EU traffic to US for 10m.

deploy-bot: EU smoke passed after retry. metrics: p95=720ms, error_rate=0.5%. progressing to 30% per plan.

rashid: APAC warm verification pending; do not start APAC until EU stable 15m.

deploy-bot: EU stable 16m. APAC warm-pool check: target 18 active 18. APAC canary 5% started ap-southeast1.

eli: monitor p99 closely for APAC initial spikes. Keep rollback playbook handy.

deploy-bot: APAC smoke pass. Final ramp to 100% across regions scheduled and completed without automated rollback.

eli: thanks all. Follow-ups: reduce model-pull retries, tighten autoscaler ramp. I'll file tickets.
